sourcesPage.title: Data Sources
sourcesPage.filterPlaceholder: Filter by source ID or type…
sourcesPage.purposeBody: A source is one registered connection to a system that holds data — a database, a warehouse, a file store, an API. Registering it lets Provisa read that system's schemas and query it in the same language as every other source, without copying the data anywhere.
sourcesPage.purposeAdd: Adding a source registers no tables on its own. Use Discover on the row to browse its schemas and register the tables you want governed.
